business.description: Worldwide Aluminium Ltd. (formerly Worldwide Leather Exports Ltd.) generated revenue of Rs. 7882.53 lacs in FY 2025-26 with a net profit of Rs. 12.95 lacs. The company has not changed its line of business during the period.

outlook.statement: The Board is taking the necessary steps to improve the performance of the Company and to have better working results in the coming years.

Your Company expects turn around in its performance in coming year on several initiatives taken by the Company. The Company continues to explore the possibilities of expansion and will make the necessary investments when attractive opportunities arise.
